{"metadata":{"description":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 插件：在设置页管理 MCP 服务器——列出已安装工具，添加/编辑/删除、启用/停用；组合配置提供的 MCP 同样可在运行时直接编辑、停用、移除并恢复，无需重启宿主。","id":"gh:1336968253","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-mcp-manage","slug":"null119/dsh-mcp-manage","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 插件：在设置页管理 MCP 服务器——列出已安装工具，添加/编辑/删除、启用/停用；组合配置提供的 MCP 同样可在运行时直接编辑、停用、移除"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"k Harness）Web GUI 插件：在设置页管理 MCP 服务器——列出已安装工具，添加/编辑/删除、启用/停用；组合配置提供的 MCP 同样可在运行时直接编辑、停用、移除并恢复，无需重启宿主。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-mcp-manage"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web GUI 的 MCP 管理插件：在 **设置 → MCP 管理** 页面里查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用/停用 MCP 服务器；组合配置（cordis.y"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ml / patch）提供的 MCP 同样可在运行时直接管理。全部操作即时生效，无需重启宿主，也无需修改任何 dsh 源码。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **查看所有已安装的 MCP 工具**：每个服务器以“N 个工具”可点击计数展示，点击展开/收起工具列表（`mcp__名称__*`），默认隐藏。
- **添加**：支持 `stdio`（本地命令 "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"+ 参数 + 环境变量 + 工作目录）与 `streamable-http`（URL + 附加请求头）两种传输；保存后立即加载为运行实例，工具马上注册到会话。
- **修改**：编辑任意字段后自动以新"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"配置重启该实例。
- **删除**：卸载运行实例并删除持久化记录。
- **启用 / 停用**：一键开关，停用立即卸载、启用立即加载。
- **组合配置的 MCP 同样可管**：cordis.yml "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"/ patch 提供的行（如 cebridge）可在运行时**直接编辑**——表单从当前配置预填，保存为运行时覆盖并立即重启（停用中的行保持停用，配置待下次启用生效；编辑在停用/启用之间保留，改错再次"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"编辑即可），也可停用或移除（可随时恢复）。覆盖状态持久化并在宿主重启后自动维持；**源组合文件不会被修改**。
- **持久化**：记录与覆盖保存在 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-manage/ser"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"vers.json`，宿主重启后自动恢复所有已启用的服务器并维持组合覆盖。
- **启动失败可见**：默认 `failOnStartupError`，坏定义会显示“启动失败”及错误信息，而不是静默后台"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"s.json`，宿主重启后自动恢复所有已启用的服务器并维持组合覆盖。
- **启动失败可见**：默认 `failOnStartupError`，坏定义会显示“启动失败”及错误信息，而不是静默后台重试。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"然后重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → MCP 管理**。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"要求：DSH ≥ `0.1.0-rc.6`（组合中已包含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`）。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 卸载"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"管理页删除所有记录后，`$DSH_HOME/mcp-manage/` 可以安全移除。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 工作原理"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **host 半**（`src/index.ts` + `src/host/`）：在 `ctx.webServer` 上注册 `/api/dsh-mcp-manage/*` 路由族；每个启用的记录"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"通过 `ctx.plugin()` 加载为一个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 实例（作为本插件 fiber 的 effect 作用域子节点，插件卸载时自动清理）。`@de"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"epseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 从运行中的 dsh 安装解析（可选 peer 依赖），本插件自身不携带它。组合行管理走 Loader 的 `Entry.update` / `gro"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"up.remove`（**绕过 `tree.write()`**，不物化、不修改源组合文件）：启用开关与配置编辑（`PUT /external/:entryId/config`，载荷与受管编辑同构，经"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"同一 `toConfig` 映射生成客户端配置）都经 `Entry.update` 即时重启行内实例，首次编辑快照原始 loader 选项供还原（`POST /external/:entryId/re"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"vert`）。覆盖状态存于本插件存储，通过 `loader/entry-init` / `loader/config-update` 钩子与列表读取时的收敛式强化在启动与热重载后自动重建。
- **c"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"lient 半**（`src/client/`）：通过 `dsh.client` 声明加载到 Web GUI，向 `settings.section` 槽位注册 "MCP 管理" 导航页，纯 `fet"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ch` 与 host 半通信。
- 工具枚举读取 `ctx.tools.schemas()` 中所有 `mcp__*` 前缀的名字，按 `serverName` 分组——这就是“当前宿主已安装的全部 "},{"id":"p15s9","text":"信。
- 工具枚举读取 `ctx.tools.schemas()` 中所有 `mcp__*` 前缀的名字，按 `serverName` 分组——这就是“当前宿主已安装的全部 MCP 工具”的权威列表。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## dsh.bundle 声明清单"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **List every installed MCP tool**: each server shows a clickable "N 个工具" count that expands/collap"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ses its tool list (`mcp__name__*`), hidden by default.
- **Add**: `stdio` (command / args / env / cw"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"d) and `streamable-http` (URL / headers) transports; saving loads a live instance immediately and it"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"s tools register right away.
- **Edit**: restarting the instance under the new config is automatic.
"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"- **Delete**: dispose the live instance and remove the persisted record.
- **Enable / disable**: one"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" toggle — disable unloads at once, enable loads immediately.
- **Composition-provided MCP rows are f"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"irst-class too**: rows from `cordis.yml` / patches (e.g. cebridge) can be **edited at runtime** — th"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"e form prefills from the row's current config, the edit persists as an override and restarts the row"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" immediately (a disabled row stays dormant and picks the config up on the next enable; edits survive"},{"id":"p19s10","text":" toggles, and a mistake is fixed by editing again) — and can equally be disabled or removed (restora"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"ble). Overrides persist across host restarts and the **source composition files are never modified**"},{"id":"p19s12","text":".
- **Persistence**: records and overrides live in `$DSH_HOME/mcp-manage/servers.json`; enabled serv"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"ers and composition overrides are restored on host start.
- **Loud failures**: bad definitions surfa"},{"id":"p19s14","text":"ce as a failed row with the error text instead of silent background retries."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The host half serves `/api/dsh-mcp-manage/*` on `ctx.webServer` and loads each enabled record as an "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` instance (an effect-scoped child of this plugin's fiber — disposal cas"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"cades automatically; the client package resolves from the running dsh installation as an optional pe"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"er). The browser half registers the settings page through the `settings.section` slot and talks to t"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"he host over plain fetch. Tool enumeration reads `ctx.tools.schemas()` and groups every `mcp__*` nam"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"e by server namespace. Composition rows are managed through the loader's `Entry.update` / `group.rem"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ove` (bypassing `tree.write()` — nothing is materialized back into the source composition files): th"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"e enable toggle and the runtime config edit (`PUT /external/:entryId/config`, a payload shaped like "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"the managed edit, mapped through the same `toConfig`) both restart the row's fiber immediately, the "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"original loader options are snapshotted on first edit for revert (`POST /external/:entryId/revert`),"},{"id":"p21s11","text":" and persisted overrides are re-enforced after boot and hot reloads via the `loader/entry-init` / `l"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"oader/config-update` hooks."}],"truncated":true}
